name: Stalwart
text: Cannot be pushed or pulled. (Expressed as immune: push, pull.)

name: Mothmaker
text: A Snuff Minion or Soldier killed by her Strike becomes a Velvet Moth you own on that tile (Exhausted, if the unit limit allows). Never for rivals or bosses. Her strikes never Take.

name: Quick Build
text: His Lanterns and Wick Mortars arrive Ready.

name: Flourish
text: When her own Strike kills, she gets 1 extra Strike this seat turn (at most 2 per seat turn).

name: Promotion
text: When its Strike kills, it becomes a Taper Captain with full HP.

name: Censer
text: At Tally, heals 1 HP to each adjacent allied piece (not itself).

name: Shieldbearer
text: Arrives with Ward. (Expressed as startStatuses: ward.)

name: Battering
text: A target that survives its Strike is pushed 2. (Expressed as attack.push 2.)

name: Webs
text: Its Strike applies Dazed. (Expressed as attack.status dazed.)

name: Heavy
text: Cannot be pushed, pulled or swapped. Its Strike pushes 1 if the target survives. (immune: displacement; attack.push 1.)

name: Pop
text: When it dies, it deals 1 damage to each adjacent enemy.

name: Twin Knives
text: Its Strike hits twice (2 instances of 1 damage). (Expressed as attack.times 2.)

name: Crown
text: Vigil only: if it ends a Snuff Move on rank 1, it becomes a Drip Hulk at full HP.

name: Wax Pool
text: When it dies, its tile becomes Hot Wax.

name: Belch
text: At each Plume placement, adds 1 Sootling Plume on a legal tile within 2 of itself.
